t.eng-ummmuhammad: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
And the earth discharges its burdens
And man says, "What is [wrong] with it
That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has commanded it

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰ ا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
ayahs.translit: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرࣰ ا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translit: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّ ا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translit: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it
